candidate.educational_objective: Teach the principal sedation-related safety precautions for OTC diphenhydramine.

options.A: Marked drowsiness may occur, so use caution with driving and avoid alcohol.
options.B: The medication cannot cause drowsiness at any dose.
options.D: The medication should be used to make a child sleepy.

candidate.rationale: Current OTC diphenhydramine labeling warns that marked drowsiness may occur, advises caution when driving or operating machinery, and states that alcohol, sedatives, and tranquilizers may increase drowsiness. The label also states not to use the product to make a child sleepy.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Diphenhydramine may cause marked drowsiness and requires driving/alcohol precautions.
candidate.source_locator: Drug Facts—When using this product: marked drowsiness; alcohol/sedatives/tranquilizers increase drowsiness
candidate.stem: A client plans to take OTC diphenhydramine for allergy symptoms. Which teaching is most important?
